title: Bijectivity of specified unit-cohomology transport through a scheme isomorphism
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, d:X→Y a scheme isomorphism [def-pc-scheme], f:Y→Spec R and fprime:X→Spec R with d followed by f equal to fprime, M a module on Y, and e:M≅O_Y. For every n≥0, unitCohomologyPullbackLinear(f,fprime,d,hd,M,e.hom followed by unitToPushforwardObjUnit d,n) [def-pbc-unit-cohomology-pullback-linear] is bijective. The statement concerns only invertibility of this specified map, and has no cartesian-square or comparison-compatibility conclusion.

source.place: cohomology-equation-functorial; exact inverse-image action on Ext, and Mathlib adjunction and unit pullback APIs

proof.text: Inverse image along a scheme isomorphism is an equivalence of abelian sheaf categories, hence fully faithful and preserving injectives. Apply the upstream Sheaf.H.mapFunctor_bijective to its Ext action.

The structural unit coefficient map is invertible for an isomorphism of ringed spaces. Its precomposition by the forgotten e is invertible too. Its induced cohomology map is therefore bijective; compose with the Ext-action bijection.

proof_origin.place: The explicit Ext comparison, naturality and functoriality; the complete argument is in the Lean docstring.
